text: I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass. To determine the underlying cause, do you know if you have a history of ovarian cancer or any family members who have had it?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial hyperplasia with concurrent adnexal mass (likely benign cyst or fibroma).
